headlines.title: Boston Scientific Prices $7.66 Billion in Notes to Fund Penumbra Acquisition
headlines.line: Boston Scientific has priced a $7.66 billion debt offering, consisting of both US dollar and euro-denominated notes, to finance its planned acquisition of Penumbra, Inc.

headlines.title: Alphabet Announces $4.19 Billion Canadian Bond Offering
headlines.line: Alphabet Inc. has initiated a debt offering in Canada to raise approximately $4.19 billion.

headlines.title: Disney Declines to Bid for 2030 and 2034 World Cup Broadcast Rights
headlines.line: The Walt Disney Company, through its ESPN division, has reportedly decided not to submit a bid for the broadcast rights to the 2030 and 2034 FIFA World Cup tournaments.

headlines.title: Amended Class Action Lawsuit Filed Against Alphabet Inc.
headlines.line: Law firms have filed an amended class action complaint against Alphabet Inc. regarding disclosures related to the Gemini 3.5 Pro AI model and third-quarter 2026 financial results.

headlines.title: Indonesian Government Seeks Clarification from Google on YouTube Channel Removals
headlines.line: The Indonesian government has requested clarification from Google regarding the removal of 19,000 YouTube channels.

headlines.title: Disney Declines to Bid for Certain Sports Rights
headlines.line: Disney has reportedly decided against pursuing a specific sports rights package for its ESPN division, citing cost concerns and upcoming renewal obligations.

headlines.title: Walt Disney Imagineering Unveils AI-Powered Anzellan Characters
headlines.line: Walt Disney Imagineering, in collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS), has introduced new autonomous Audio-Animatronics characters based on the Anzellan species from Star Wars.

headlines.title: Gorilla Technology Reports Record Q3 2026 Financial Results
headlines.line: Gorilla Technology Group Inc. announced record quarterly revenue of US$69.5 million for Q3 2026, marking a 162.6% year-over-year increase and a 38.7% sequential rise.

headlines.title: Photon Energy N.V. Defers Green Bond Coupon Payment
headlines.line: Photon Energy N.V. announced the deferral of the coupon payment due on 23 November 2026 for its 6.5% Green Bond, citing ongoing liquidity constraints and restructuring.

headlines.title: Commerzbank Raises 2026 Net Profit Outlook
headlines.line: CEO Bettina Orlopp announced an upward revision to the bank's 2026 net profit forecast to €3.5 billion, citing improved cost management and tax benefits.

headlines.title: Commerzbank AG (London Branch) Issues Post-Stabilisation Notice
headlines.line: Commerzbank AG (London Branch) confirmed that no stabilization action was taken regarding the offer of Allianz Finance II B.V. notes.

headlines.title: Truist Securities Upgrades Evolent Health to Buy
headlines.line: Truist Securities upgraded Evolent Health, Inc. (EVH) from Hold to Buy, keeping its price target at $6.

headlines.title: STMicroelectronics Announces Over 100 Million Euro Investment in Rousset Site
headlines.line: STMicroelectronics is investing more than 100 million euros to expand and modernize its production facility in Rousset, France.

headlines.title: Analyst Actions: HSBC and TD Cowen Update Ratings on UnitedHealth Group
headlines.line: HSBC adjusted its price target for UnitedHealth Group, while TD Cowen upgraded the company's stock to Buy.

headlines.title: Citigroup Injects Capital Into Unit Following Trade Recording Error
headlines.line: Citigroup has injected capital into a business unit after a trade recording error led to an understatement of risk-weighted assets by approximately $35 billion.

summary:
Broad US equities fell sharply in the previous session (2026-11-19). SPY closed down 1.96% and is down 5.45% over five days, with QQQ down 2.19% and IWM down 2.18%. Technology (XLK, -1.90%) and consumer discretionary (XLY, -2.79%) led the declines, while staples (-1.45%) and utilities (-1.24%) fell less. The VIX proxy VIXY rose 12.16%. Gold fell 1.76%, long Treasuries (TLT) rose 0.16%, and oil (USO) gained 1.45%.

Economic data were mixed to soft. The Philadelphia Fed manufacturing index printed 6.3 against a 20.6 consensus, and initial jobless claims were 203K against 198K expected. The KC Fed manufacturing index rose to 23 from 16.

Pre-market, SPY is down 0.84%, QQQ down 1.65%, and XLK down 2.35%. Today's calendar includes the University of Michigan sentiment release (consensus 51.0) and several Fed speakers.

Single-stock pre-market moves rest on thin volume and may not reflect actual prices. Notable headlines include Boston Scientific's $7.66 billion note offering to fund its Penumbra acquisition and Alphabet's roughly $4.19 billion Canadian bond offering.
